tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Dance Terminology & Action Words

questions.question: Q: Name the six types of action content.
questions.correctAnswer: Travel, turn, jump, gesture, stillness and transfer of weight.

questions.question: Q: How does dynamic content differ from action content?
questions.correctAnswer: Action content describes what the body does (e.g. jump); dynamic content describes how it is performed (e.g. sudden, strong jump versus sustained, light rise).

questions.question: Q: Give an example of spatial content in a dance.
questions.correctAnswer: A dancer moving in a circular pathway at a high level across the general space, using diagonal direction towards downstage left.

tests.name: Exam-Style Practice
tests.description: Short-answer practice on Dance Terminology & Action Words

questions.question: Q: Name three types of relationship content.
questions.correctAnswer: Unison, canon and contact — though contrast, complement and leader-follower are also valid.

questions.question: Q: Why is it important to use all four content categories when analysing a dance?
questions.correctAnswer: Using all four categories ensures you cover every aspect of the movement — action, dynamics, space and relationships — giving a thorough and complete analysis.
